title: Mobile lab captures show LCP above the checklist threshold on sampled pages
observation: The mobile LAB artifact records LCP 20,456 ms on the homepage, 19,952 ms on /benh-ly, and 18,956 ms on the diabetes-health article listing; the checklist target is under 2.5 seconds.

impact.user: Slow observed rendering can delay access to product and health information.
impact.business: Long wait times may interrupt discovery and evaluation.
impact.seo: The sampled LAB values exceed the stated performance target.
impact.technical: The measured LCP values are 7.6 to 8.2 times the 2,500 ms target.

suggested_direction: Profile and reduce the observed largest-contentful paint path, then repeat comparable mobile lab runs.
unknowns: These are single audit-browser LAB observations, not field Core Web Vitals or PageSpeed Insights scores; all page collections remain partial.
